details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (financial performance), K2 (net loans and interest rates), K3 (market revitalization), K4 (Rannakalda sales progress), K6 (Arco Vara development site acquisition), and K7 (Botanica Lozen project progress). However, it omits the core material meaning of K5 (Soodi 6 project details), K8 (Arcojärve project status), K9 (Kodulahe development planning), and K10 (Merivälja Kuldlehe cluster house sales). details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build upon each other without contradiction: profitability improvements (S1, S4, S5) are logically supported by revenue growth (S2, S3) and margin management. Operational cash flow increases (S6) are clearly explained by investment activity. Balance sheet metrics (S8, S10) align with the profitability narrative without conflicting implications. The commercial execution details (S11-S13, S15) provide contextual support for financial performance. Organizational structure flows logically from financial highlights to operational updates to market context. No material repetitions or logical gaps are present, and all relationships between figures and explanations are internally consistent.
